# Refine

> > Refine is an open-source React framework for building enterprise-grade internal tools, admin panels, and B2B applications with AI-powered code generation, supporting integrations with Supabase, Auth0, Azure AD, and modern UI libraries.

Refine (currently at v5) positions itself as an open-source alternative to Retool, offering a headless architecture that works with React Router, Next.js, and Remix. Backed by Y Combinator and 500 Emerging Europe, it provides comprehensive authentication (OAuth, Web3), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data provider patterns for rapid enterprise application development.

## Key Topics

- Refine v5
- React Framework
- Internal Tools & Admin Panels
- AI Code Generation
- Authentication (Auth0, Azure AD, Okta, Amazon Cognito)
- Authorization (RBAC, ABAC, ACL)
- Data Providers (Supabase, REST API)
- UI Libraries (shadcn/ui, Ant Design, Material UI)
- Routing (React Router, Next.js, Remix)
- Access Control & Multitenancy
- Web3 & Ethereum Integration
- Self-Hosting & Open Source
- CRUD Operations & Data Fetching
- Enterprise B2B Applications

## Getting Started

- [Refine Homepage](https://refine.dev): Main homepage: AI-powered React framework for internal tools and B2B apps
- [Refine Core Overview](https://refine.dev/core): Open-source React framework alternative to Retool for enterprise admin panels
- [AI-Powered Builder](https://ai.refine.dev): AI-powered platform for building React internal apps with Supabase/REST APIs
- [Quickstart Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/getting-started/quickstart): Quick start guide for Refine v5 with shadcn/ui, Auth0, Azure AD support
- [Your First Refine App](https://refine.dev/core/tutorial/essentials/setup): Tutorial: Create first Refine app using create-refine-app with Vite/React
- [Tutorial Introduction](https://refine.dev/core/tutorial/essentials/intro): Tutorial intro covering CRUD essentials with React Router, Next.js, Remix

## Documentation & Guides

- [Main Documentation](https://refine.dev/core/docs): Main documentation hub for Refine v5 with guides, tutorials, and API refs
- [Guides & Concepts Overview](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts): Guides hub: Data fetching, forms, auth (OAuth/JWT), RBAC/ABAC, routing
- [Authentication Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/authentication): Auth guide: OAuth, Auth0, Azure AD, Web3/Ethereum authentication patterns
- [Access Control Tutorial](https://refine.dev/core/docs/advanced-tutorials/access-control): Advanced tutorial: Role-based access control with Casbin in Refine v5
- [Tables Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/tables): Tables guide: Best practices for data display in Refine v5 applications
- [Development Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/development): Development setup guide: Devtools and commands for Refine v5 projects
- [Testing Guide](https://refine.dev/docs/further-readings/testing): Testing best practices: Unit and end-to-end testing strategies for Refine
